topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain's been falling all night, just like the whiskey down my throat. Lenny called, his voice barely above a whisper. Said he couldn't stick around, not with the way things are. His lease is up, new job lined up, clear across the country. moet move on, he says. I knew it was coming, maybe. But knowing don't stop the hurt. I asked him about the times, the deals we'd made, the backs we'd watched. He said it's different now, life's a different game. I don't know what to believe anymore. Folks come and go, but Lenny... he was the one constant. The city's a lonely place, especially in the rain. Maybe I'll just have another drink and let the night pass, see if the morning brings any answers. Doubtful, but a man's gotta hope.
